title: Xi presses Trump to halt Taiwan arms sales.
body: Reuters reports that at the Sept 24 White House meeting, Xi will cite the 1982 US-China communiqué to push Washington into winding down arms sales to us. Sources say Beijing also wants approved deliveries paused. Reagan's memo tied that wind-down to one condition: that China stays committed to a peaceful settlement.
highlight: Reagan's memo tied that wind-down to one condition
kapa_line: The communiqué sets a condition. Beijing wants the result without it.
ig_caption:
Xi wants Trump to halt arms sales to Taiwan, citing the 1982 communiqué. Reagan's own memo tied any wind-down to one condition: Beijing staying committed to a peaceful settlement.

🐸 Kapa: The communiqué sets a condition. Beijing wants the result without it.

Source: Reuters, 22 Sep 2026
